text:
mira: Quick sync on the 'Create Dataset' form validation and the dataset deletion flow. Two separate questions: 1) placement/format of inline errors (icon left, text below, or compact inline after field?) and 2) safest but least annoying destructive confirm for datasets. Screenshot & prototype: https://figma.redwood/dataset-form.

taylor: For inline errors I prefer the message below the field, left-aligned with the input, with a small error icon to the left. Helps scanning. If we show an error summary at the top it should be a compact list with anchor links to the fields.

owen: Agree on anchors. For long forms the summary should include numbered bullets so keyboard users can tab through: "1. Title: title is required (jump)". The anchor should set focus to the first invalid control.

lee: Question about visual affordance: do we animate the error appearance? subtle fade-in feels less jarring, but avoid motion for reduced-motion prefs. Code idea:```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .error { transition: none; }
}
```

mira: Good call on reduced-motion. Also accessibility: inline errors must be programmatically associated with inputs using aria-describedby and the summary should have role="alert" or aria-live so SR users know something changed.

pm-jo: From PM: minimize friction for creators. If the only issue is a missing optional field, we shouldn't force a full-blocking summary. What's the threshold for showing top-level blocking vs inline?

taylor: Blocking summary only on submit when there are >=2 errors or if server-side validation fails. Single-field client-side errors should remain inline. Server errors (e.g., duplicate name) should show toast + open the relevant field.

owen: For server-side errors include an actionable copy + link to retry or contact support. Example: "Dataset name already exists — change the name or see conflicting datasets (link)". Also include an error code for observability.

lee: Required markers: idea to use a subtle label "required" for complex fields (like schema) and only asterisk for single-line inputs. Must test contrast. :mag:

mira: Let's aim for both: asterisk visually for density, and sr-only "required" string for screen reader. If field is complex, show persistent "Required" below the label.

pm-jo: Deletion flow: ops wants typed-confirm, design worries about speed for power users. Can we tier based on dataset sensitivity or age?

taylor: Tiered confirms seems good: if dataset has "public" or > X uses then typed-confirm, else checkbox + delay? Alternative: typed-confirm behind a toggle in settings for teams who want max safety.

owen: Another option: show a short 5s countdown before the final button becomes active. Countdown helps prevent accidental clicks but less friction than typing. Combine with a big RED warning.

lee: If we do typed-confirm, require exact phrase including dataset name to reduce accidental matches. Regex: `^Delete dataset: MyDataset$` — but be careful with quoting and long names. Truncate display name in the prompt if >60 chars.

mira: Accessibility notes for modal: role="alertdialog", aria-labelledby to the heading, aria-describedby to the explanatory paragraph. Focus moves into the modal and returns to the delete button on cancel. Use live region updates only for severe errors.

a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: 1) Ensure aria-describedby IDs are unique on page, 2) error regions use aria-live="assertive" for blocking errors, 3) error links include clear names (e.g., "Fix Title input"), 4) confirm input has aria-label and autocomplete="off" for typed-confirm, 5) keyboard-only users can operate countdown (skip via checkbox if configured). Also ensure color+icon redundancy for colorblind users.

pm-jo: Telemetry/PX: capture confirm_type (none|checkbox|typed|countdown), delete_confirm_result (confirmed|cancelled|timeout), and error_origin (client|server). We'll use this to tune defaults.

taylor: E2E and a11y tests: add cases for screenreader announcing summary on submit, anchor focus from summary links, typed-confirm exact-match, countdown respects prefers-reduced-motion, and cancel returns focus.

owen: UX microcopy suggestions for errors: avoid terse "Invalid". Prefer: "Title — please provide a name for the dataset." For server duplicates: "Name already used — rename or choose a unique suffix."

lee: Small UI nit: if we show icons, use aria-hidden="true" and include the status text in the accessible label. Don't rely on icon alone.

mira: Action items: mira -> update prototypes with three inline variants (icon-left + below text, compact inline after field, and field-only asterisk) and a top summary design with numbered anchors; taylor -> draft microcopy for all errors and confirm dialogs; owen -> e2e + telemetry plan; lee -> accessibility modal checklist and contrast tests; pm-jo -> pick default confirm policy for GA.

pm-jo: Will coordinate with security for the threshold rules and report back by Friday.

mira: Thanks everyone. Will ping when the mocks are up for quick review. :sparkles:
